Name: Sebastian for Portraiture by sab_lya
Author: cemeterysablya
Description:
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] and its requirements.
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]PortraiturePlus[/url] (for seasonal outfit changes!)
3. Create a new folder inside [i]Mods\Portraiture\Portraits [/i]if you haven't already, title it whatever you want 
4. Unzip this mod and extract the three downloaded .png files into the new folder in Portraiture.


While playing simply speak to a character and press "P" while dialogue window is open to change portraits!
